$comment: Single source of truth for the Slider API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: slider
title: Slider
description: Choose a number, or a range, by dragging.

value / defaultValue.description: One number, or [from, to] for a range with two thumbs. Use onValueChange to hear about changes.
value / defaultValue.html: value + style="--vin-fill: 40%"; a range: aria-valuenow on each thumb + style="--vin-from: .2; --vin-to: .7"

min / max / step.html: min, max, step attributes (a range: data-min, data-max, data-step)

label.description: Visible label. Without it, pass an aria-label.

showValue.description: Show the value next to the label.

formatValue.html: data-format="₹{value}" on the output (a range: also on .vin-range, for aria-valuetext)

thumbLabels.description: Range only: names for the two thumbs.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A native range input with its label and value. In HTML, add data-vin-slider and include vinui.js so the fill and the value follow the thumb.

examples.title: Range
examples.description: Pass [from, to] for two thumbs. Each thumb is its own slider with its own name, and they can't cross. Click the track to move the nearest thumb.

examples.title: Steps and disabled
examples.description: Snap to steps with step. A disabled slider keeps its value visible.

a11y: One value: a native <input type="range">; arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home/End and touch all work, and screen readers announce the value.
A range follows the WAI-ARIA multi-thumb slider pattern: two role="slider" thumbs with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin/max and aria-valuetext, each in the Tab order.
Every thumb has a name: the label, or an aria-label for each thumb of a range.
The value is also shown as text in an <output>, so it is not only conveyed by position.
Thumbs have a 30px touch area and a visible focus ring in every style and mode.
